name: labs/kajalbiju__psi_bluesky_backend
title: Oxford Instruments Mercury iTC temperature controller (PSI Bluesky4)
intro: Oxford Instruments Mercury iTC temperature controller (PSI Bluesky4), adapted from kajalbiju/psi_bluesky_backend. It reads `temperature`; sets `temperature_setpoint`, `heater_setpoint`, `p_value`, `i_value` and 1 more; runs `heater_off`. `heater_off`: drive the temperature-loop setpoint to 0 K and the heater-loop setpoint to 0 (the safe state); it takes no input. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
